newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil ends higher on afternoon support.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil ends higher on afternoon support.

text.p: Palm oil prices surged in the afternoon session on fresh trade buying and talk of a Pakistani tender soon after moving in tight ranges earlier, trader said.

"The afternoon market came back to live. There was a sudden burst of trade buying interest and there was a lot of switching activity," a trader said, adding that spread trades were mostly seen from March to April, March to May and Feb to April.
"People are trying to get rid of the nearby futures and buying forward," the trader said.
Another trader said there was some fresh participation seen in physical sector and sentiment was spilled over to futures.
"There was more buying when third month was above the 1,270 ringgit level and buying was seen from refiners and dealers," the trader added.
Talk that Pakistan will issue tenders soon also triggered some speculative interest. But there was no confirmation on this tender talk, they said.
"Demand looks bad in recent weeks and major buyers had not been in the market for sometimes and the market is expected buyers like India and Pakistan to come in," the trader said.
The market fluctuated narrowly in earlier sessions with players uncertain of the market trend.
Third month, April futures closed nine ringgit up at 1,274 ringgit ($511.03) a tonne.
Physical Jan (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,340 against bids at 1,330 after trading at 1,330 to 1,332.50.
Jan (central) was offered at 1,335 and bids at 1,330 with early trades at 1,330.
Feb (south) saw offers at 1,335 with bids at 1,330 with earlier trades of 1,330 and 1,335 and Feb (central) at 1,335 against 1,325.
Among refined products, Feb RBD palm oil was offered at $565 a tonne FOB Malaysia and Mar at $557.50 and Apr/May/Jun at $547.50.
Feb RBD palm olein saw offers at $595, Mar at $590 and Apr/May/Jun at $577.50. Feb was traded at $592.50 and Mar at $587.50.
Feb/Mar RBD palm stearin was offered at $452.50 and and Feb/Mar palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $305.
